metadata.rationale: Based on forward-test performance across Alpha Engine (165 trades), ATM Challenge (852 trades), Mercury2 (46 trades), Baby Battleground (117 trades). Core = positive expectancy + statistical significance. Kill = 0-25% WR with negative PnL.

data_quality_audit.pnl_format: All pnl_pct values are decimals (e.g., 0.05 = 5%), range -0.05 to +0.12. Consistent format, no mixed percentage values found.

conflicts_found.issue: status=LOST but exit_reason=TP_HIT, pnl_pct=-0.204 (TP_HIT should imply WON)
conflicts_found.likely_cause: TP was hit but at a loss due to partial fill or price gap

conflicts_found.issue: status=LOST but exit_reason=TP_HIT, pnl_pct=-0.383 (TP set below entry?)
conflicts_found.likely_cause: SHORT trade where TP direction was inverted in exit logic

conflicts_found.issue: status=WON but exit_reason=SL_HIT, pnl_pct=+0.023 (SL_HIT should imply LOST)
conflicts_found.likely_cause: Trailing stop moved above entry, SL hit was actually profitable
Breakeven stop triggered, classified as WON due to positive pnl

normalization_rules.status_canonical: WON if pnl_pct > 0, LOST if pnl_pct < 0, CLOSED if pnl_pct == 0
normalization_rules.note: Consumers should use pnl_pct sign as ground truth for win/loss, not status or exit_reason. The 4 conflicts above are edge cases in the exit logic where trailing stops or TP direction for SHORTs produces mismatched status/exit_reason.
